policy.builtin_first: Every profile ships ~57 builtin skills enabled by default (test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, github, codebase-inspection, computer-use, google-workspace, arxiv...). Run hermes -p <profile> skills list first — a builtin covering the role's need satisfies it; never install a duplicate of an enabled builtin.
policy.forge_library: Custom skills authored in this repo, under skills/library/. Install per profile via direct URL: hermes -p <profile> skills install https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juliench82/hermes-agents-forge/main/skills/library/<skill>/SKILL.md --category <category> --yes. Frontmatter name and category resolve automatically; --yes skips only the confirmation prompt — Hermes's built-in security scanner still runs on every install. Never --force past a verdict.
policy.generative: For a role no builtin or library skill covers, author a bespoke skill with the skill_manage tool (create action): house format (When to Use / Procedure / Pitfalls / Verification), description under 60 characters, no invented commands, grounded in the user's interview answers.
policy.discovery: hermes skills search <query> — confirm a skill exists before installing it
policy.inspect: hermes skills inspect <skill> — read what it does before installing
policy.verify: hermes -p <profile> skills list — record the inventory after install

security_gate.rule: Every hub and direct-URL install is quarantined, scanned, and given a verdict automatically. --yes skips only the confirmation prompt, never the scan. On a dangerous verdict: skip, report, never --force. (An optional NVIDIA SkillEvaluator/SkillSpector advisory scan exists if installed; advisory only.)

policy.never: Never invent skill names. A rejected name means stop — not retry with new guesses.

prd-author.for: analyst / product roles — idea to requirements

blueprint.for: architect roles — requirements to technical plan

qa-gate.for: QA roles — test plans, definition of done

feed-craft.for: social/content roles — brand voice, cadence, approval

trusted_packs.name: superpowers
trusted_packs.note: Agentic dev methodology pack (TDD, debugging, planning, collaboration patterns). Install via direct-URL skill install; the built-in scanner runs automatically.
trusted_packs.verification: unverified-in-hub — run hermes skills search superpowers first; if not on the Hub, install by URL only after the scan verdict is clean

rule: Four tiers, in order: check the profile's enabled builtins, install Forge library skills per role by direct URL, generate a bespoke skill via skill_manage for uncovered roles, and fill genuine gaps from the Hub. Report coverage per profile — never silence.
